purpose: Source-grounded semantic decisions for the nine proposed secondary bindings and six selector/field custom_data candidates. This is a review record only; it never authorizes renderer projection or payload materialization.

review_basis.method: Inspected the nine pinned Challenge JSON files, nine pinned mechanic implementations, FrameSnapshot, ChallengeRuntimeBridge, canonical migration/profile resolution, and the existing V1 fixture path; all 81 V2-C source input pins match this designated ZIP. The active Windows checkout itself was not directly mounted in this environment.

v2c_runtime_evidence.scope: source-frame and canonical runtime-route acceptance only; not visual payload acceptance or seed sensitivity
v2c_runtime_evidence.evidence_authority: operator-confirmed output pasted in conversation; not an independently re-read Windows report file from this environment

base_snapshot_fields.note: Primary position track; coordinate authority remains selector-specific.
Angular units and asset transform semantics need an explicit projection contract.
Default Vector2.ONE for many mechanics; presentation scale semantics remain separate.
Finite source field; no renderer opacity mapping authorized.
Default zero unless mechanic supplies a variant; asset-role mapping needs review.
Default zero unless supplied; do not infer asset selection from its shape alone.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: The challenge declares presentation.static_target_position=[540,960] in CANVAS_1080X1920, but KeyMechanic.setup reads only rotation tolerance; KeyMechanic.target_position remains its code default Vector2(540,960). The numeric values match today, but the simulation does not consume the presentation property. This is duplicated authority, not a live binding.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: KeyMechanic.simulate compares the actor snapshot position to the mechanic member target_position; setup does not read presentation.static_target_position.
selector_reviews.units_and_coordinate_space: Vector2 in the declared CANVAS_1080X1920 challenge coordinate space; keep source coordinates unprojected.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Static per challenge, not sampled from FrameSnapshot.custom_data.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Block any target binding if the presentation field is missing or mismatches the mechanic authority; do not silently substitute one source for the other.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: Target candidate is static and should be seed-invariant; actor track may be seed-sensitive through KeyMechanic RNG.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Resolve a single documented source of truth or add a fail-closed parity assertion in a separately reviewed increment. No code change or approval here.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: difficulty.parking.target_position=[850,960] is parsed into ParkingMechanic.target_pos, but the challenge does not declare presentation.coordinate_space.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: ParkingMechanic.setup reads difficulty.parking.target_position and converts its two values to Vector2; that vector is used as the simulation target center.
selector_reviews.units_and_coordinate_space: Vector2 values are present, but coordinate space is UNDECLARED_IN_CHALLENGE_SOURCE. Do not infer canvas coordinates from the values or asset family.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Block projection if the target field, its two finite numeric components or explicit coordinate authority are missing.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: The static configured target is seed-invariant; the primary parking trajectory is seeded and can vary.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Resolve coordinate authority explicitly without editing frozen or challenge source as part of this review.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: PilotMechanic emits custom_data.target_x as a float computed per frame from target_start + target_velocity * frame_index. The challenge explicitly declares PILOT_0X100.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: snapshot.position is Vector2(x,0.0), while target_x is a distinct scalar track. target_x is computed from configured target parameters and frame index, not directly from the sampled RNG values.
selector_reviews.units_and_coordinate_space: float in PILOT_0X100. It is not a Vector2 and contains no Y component.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Per source simulation frame; indexed by local frame f.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: If target_x is required by a future projection and absent/non-finite, block that projection. Never invent Y or rescale into CANVAS_1080X1920 implicitly.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: target_x itself is not directly seed-sensitive; Pilot primary position is influenced by prepared trajectory/control RNG samples. Do not claim visual seed sensitivity solely from target_x.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Keep as a scalar candidate until units and visual projection are specified and separately authorized.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: difficulty.parking.target_position=[850,960] is consumed by ParkingMechanicV2, and the challenge declares CANVAS_1080X1920.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: ParkingMechanicV2 resolves the target center from migrated simulation.parameters.parking or the legacy difficulty.parking fallback. The target center controls simulation trajectory construction.
selector_reviews.units_and_coordinate_space: Vector2 in CANVAS_1080X1920. Preserve raw source coordinates; do not project or resample in this review.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Static configured target per challenge; separate from the per-frame primary vehicle snapshot.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Block if target_position is absent, malformed or non-finite; do not fallback to a newly invented coordinate.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: Target is seed-invariant while the path can change through seed-driven offsets and steering samples.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Keep the existing CHALLENGE_004 V1 binder/harness byte-for-byte unchanged as the accepted regression fixture.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: HitMechanic derives _target_prime once during setup by adding RNG-stream offsets dx/dy to the configured target, then writes that same Vector2 into custom_data.target_position for every frame.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: The primary snapshot.position is the moving projectile p_f. custom_data.target_position is _target_prime; its per-frame storage does not make it a per-frame moving target.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Per-run constant duplicated onto each source frame; derived from STREAM_HIT_TARGET_OFFSET.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: A future projection must either include the finite target vector for all frames or block; no scoring-distance fallback.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: The target candidate may change with the gameplay seed because dx/dy are sampled from the mechanic RNG context. Runtime projection sensitivity still must be tested, not inferred.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Treat as a target point/per-run state candidate, not a moving per-frame track, until explicitly projected and authorized.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: CatchMechanic computes p_t for each frame from target origin, direction, effective speed and frame index; custom_data.target_position is p_t.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: snapshot.position is p_c (the catcher); custom_data.target_position is the separate target p_t. RNG offsets from setup affect target speed/phase and catcher bias, so the target path can vary by seed.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Per source frame; exact correspondence to the same local frame index is required.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Missing, non-finite or cardinality-mismatched target_position blocks the candidate projection; never merge it into the primary catcher position.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: Potential gameplay-seed sensitivity exists via RNG-derived setup offsets, but visual projection differences must be measured in a later gate.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Maintain the separate primary catcher and secondary target tracks. No approval in this review.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: FindMechanic.calculate_frame returns p_scan and p_target; simulate assigns p_scan to snapshot.position and p_target to custom_data.target_position.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: FindMechanic.calculate_frame returns p_scan and p_target; simulate assigns p_scan to snapshot.position and p_target to custom_data.target_position. Target base and phase/drift are source-generated; distractors live separately and are not part of this candidate field.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Per source frame, aligned to calculate_frame(frame_index).
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Missing/non-finite target_position blocks this candidate; never serialize distractor topology, distances, close-call counters or all custom_data.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: Target placement/drift and scanner phases may consume separate RNG streams; seed sensitivity must be measured on an explicitly bounded projection.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: Keep scanner primary and target secondary. Explicitly exclude distractor topology and scoring telemetry.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: ChooseMechanic writes active_selection as an int option index on every frame and uses that same selection to index options_positions for snapshot.position.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: This is an index, not a coordinate, score or semantic “winner” by itself. Source positions can be independently recorded to verify index-to-position consistency.
selector_reviews.units_and_coordinate_space: int index in [0, options_count); option locations are declared in CANVAS_1080X1920.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Per source frame; current implementation precomputes selections and locks to the seed-derived winning_option in the final quarter of game frames.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Block any candidate projection when the index is missing/out of range or inconsistent with the option position.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: winning_option is derived from seed modulo options_count; actual projected output must be compared after a safe projection exists.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: The challenge declares total_duration=11 s while phases sum to 12 s. Source-frame observation only; no phase/timeline acceptance until an explicit shared temporal-policy decision.

selector_reviews.source_semantics: CountMechanic writes displayed_count as an int from its precomputed per-frame count sequence; the same value determines the X coordinate of snapshot.position.
selector_reviews.runtime_relation: displayed_count is a semantic count value and is mathematically encoded in primary position as start_pos.x + (displayed_count - min_value) * step_x. It is not target_count and not success-distance telemetry.
selector_reviews.units_and_coordinate_space: int count value; the current positional encoding uses source coordinates declared as CANVAS_1080X1920.
selector_reviews.sampling_lifecycle: Per source frame; count sequence is precomputed and locks to target_count in the final quarter of game frames.
selector_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Block a projection requiring displayed_count if it is missing, outside min_value/max_value or inconsistent with primary position; do not substitute target_count.
selector_reviews.seed_expectation: target_count is derived from generation seed modulo the configured range; visual seed sensitivity still requires a later measured projection.
selector_reviews.remaining_gate: The challenge declares total_duration=11 s while phases sum to 12 s. Source-frame observation only; no phase/timeline acceptance until an explicit shared temporal-policy decision.

custom_data_candidate_reviews.lifecycle: Per-frame scalar track; configured target_start and target_velocity, not directly RNG-sampled.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Fail closed if required and absent/non-finite; never invent a Y coordinate.

custom_data_candidate_reviews.producer: HitMechanic.setup computes _target_prime = _target + Vector2(dx,dy) from STREAM_HIT_TARGET_OFFSET; simulate repeats _target_prime in each frame.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.lifecycle: One seeded target point per simulation attempt, duplicated into every frame receipt.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Fail closed; do not replace with scoring telemetry or infer a target.

custom_data_candidate_reviews.producer: CatchMechanic.simulate writes p_t; primary snapshot.position is p_c.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.lifecycle: Per-frame target trajectory; generated from setup RNG offsets and the frame index.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Fail closed on missing/non-finite values or frame cardinality mismatch; keep target separate from catcher.

custom_data_candidate_reviews.producer: FindMechanic.calculate_frame returns p_target; simulate sets primary snapshot.position=p_scan.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.lifecycle: Per-frame target track; target base/drift and scanner phases use separate inputs/streams.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Fail closed; do not include distractor topology or scoring/close-call metadata.

custom_data_candidate_reviews.producer: ChooseMechanic.simulate writes selection after reading precomputed_selections; the same index chooses options_positions[selection].
custom_data_candidate_reviews.lifecycle: Per-frame option index; final-quarter lock position is linked to seed-derived winning_option.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.coordinate_space: Option index; declared option positions use CANVAS_1080X1920.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Fail closed if absent/out of range or inconsistent with the selected option position.

custom_data_candidate_reviews.producer: CountMechanic.simulate writes displayed value and derives snapshot.position.x from that same value.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.lifecycle: Per-frame count state; precomputed from config and generation seed, with final-quarter lock to target_count.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.coordinate_space: Count integer plus positional encoding in CANVAS_1080X1920.
custom_data_candidate_reviews.missing_value_behavior: Fail closed if missing/out of range or inconsistent with primary-position encoding; never substitute target_count.

custom_data_policy.allow_only_explicitly_reviewed_scalar_or: true only after separate approval; all six rows in this contract remain unauthorized

next_gate.name: CHALLENGE_V2B_SAFE_VISUAL_PROJECTION_RUNTIME_HARNESS_DESIGN
next_gate.entry_condition: This source semantic review record is installed add-only, its 34 focused Python checks pass in the active Windows checkout, the 81 source pins and proposal/capability contracts still match, and the operator retains zero approved bindings.
next_gate.must_prove: A separately versioned in-memory safe projection with input/field allowlist; projection repeat determinism from independent processes; actual projected-state gameplay-seed sensitivity only for mechanics/fields that truly consume gameplay seed; music-seed orthogonality via separate canonical request boundary tests; editorial identity invariance; source pins; fail-closed negatives.
next_gate.must_not_do: Do not produce payload files/media, drive renderer/native inputs, approve bindings by implication, serialize whole custom_data, alter challenge JSON, or claim phase/timeline acceptance for CHALLENGE_008/009.
